name: Sultan Mosque
description: 建于1824年的苏丹回教堂是甘榜格南的地标性建筑，拥有宏伟的金色穹顶和独特的伊斯兰建筑风格，是新加坡最古老且最重要的清真寺之一。
descriptionEn: Built in 1824, Sultan Mosque is an iconic landmark in Kampong Glam. Featuring a majestic golden dome and distinctive Islamic architecture, it is one of Singapore's most historic and prominent mosques.
openingHours: 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM, 2:00 PM - 4:00 PM（周二至周日对游客开放；周一闭馆；非礼拜时间）
openingHoursEn: 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM, 2:00 PM - 4:00 PM (Tue-Sun for visitors; Closed on Mon; outside prayer hours)
recommendNote: 参观请注意着装得体，入口处免费提供长袍。Muscat St 步行街正对穹顶，是最佳拍照机位。
recommendNoteEn: Please dress modestly; free robes are provided at the entrance. Muscat Street offers the best camera view facing the golden dome.

attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisit: 上午 10:00 开放时段（避开祈祷时间）
highlights: 金色巨大穹顶（底座由信徒收集的玻璃瓶底砌成）
伊斯兰风格主祈祷大殿
highlightsEn: Majestic Golden Dome (base formed by glass bottles donated by devotees)
